title: Machine learning-derived mast cell-associated angiogenesis features can serve as prognostic targets for clear cell renal cell carcinoma.
summary: Methods and Results: single-cell/bulk transcriptomics; LASSO+CoxBoost MCAS built and evaluated across TCGA-KIRC, E-MTAB-1980, GSE167573; qRT-PCR gene expression corroboration. Prognostic associations remain observational.
ai_technology: LASSO and CoxBoost analyze transcriptomic features to derive mast-cell-associated angiogenesis prognostic scores.
